title: Mar gaya zainab mera sher e jawaan
body:
Haye, haye, haye alamdar..(2)
Laashe abbas pe pohche jo Ghareeb e Zahra
Bhai ki laash pe ek bhai ne nauha yeh kiya
Zainab, Zainab..
<<MINI>>
Mar gaya Zainab, mera shere jawaa'n
Lashe alamdar pe sheh ne kaha
Mar gaya Zainab mera shere jawaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhse juda hogaya bhai mera
<<MINI>>
Mar gaya Zainab mera shere jawaa'n

karne do matam hume abbas ka ..(2)
hogaye bazu qalam.. Shere jawa'n mar gaya
